text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though exhausted and unsteady from the 
fierce battle for positioning in the 
Satsuki Sho, Tamamo Cross claimed victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They praised each other's efforts with 
Gold City, who had also struggled after 
being heavily marked for standing out.
